# Gymbo

> Gymbo is an iOS business app for independent personal trainers in India. It turns the day-to-day of running a training practice into a few taps: punching classes, recording payments, checking balances, scheduling, and looking professional. Monthly or annual pricing and unlimited clients. Eligible subscribers can try Gymbo free for 7 days.

Gymbo is built for the independent personal trainer, not a gym chain or dietitian. A trainer's day is classes, schedules, and payments, so Gymbo is built around that: punch a class in one tap, let the client card calculate the balance, and use colour-coded balances to see who owes you. Gymbo also includes a daily email summary, workout builder, Ask Gymbo, and a shareable QR profile card. Clients do not download anything. Gymbo is for the trainer.

## Key features

- One-tap class punches with automatic balance math
- Payment and balance tracking (cash or UPI), GST invoices, colour-coded reminders
- Scheduling and your full client roster in one place
- Workout builder with a template library + voice/paste import (build and assign workouts)
- A shareable QR profile card and branded PDF statements
- Passwordless sign-in (Apple + Face ID); works offline and syncs when back online

## Pricing

- Monthly: ₹399/month (billed monthly)
- Annual: ₹2,999 per year (₹250/month effective, save 37%)
- Unlimited clients on every plan; 7-day introductory trial for eligible subscribers
